The anchor tenant at Northgate Business Park (Vantage Fulfillment Co., which leases 62% of the net rentable area) holds **two successive five-year renewal options**. Key terms:

- **Number/length**: Two consecutive renewal terms of five years each.
- **Rent**: Exercisable at **95% of then-prevailing fair market rent**.
- **Notice requirement**: Tenant must give **twelve months' prior written notice** before exercising each option.
- **Condition**: The tenant must **not be in monetary default** at the time of exercise.

This is in addition to the initial 10-year lease term (April 1, 2025 – March 31, 2035), with no early termination rights for either party during that initial term.
